item.description: Military veteran and D.C. resident Anna King has filed a $3 million lawsuit against the Idaho National Guard, saying three guard members assaulted her while detaining her in front of her home.

item.title: These are some of the last pristine ocean ecosystems. Now, they're losing protections
item.description: The largest conservation areas in the U.S. are in the Pacific Ocean, where tiny islands are epicenters of biodiversity. The Trump administration is now opening their waters to commercial fishing, sparking a battle over some of the country's most pristine ecosystems.

item.title: House Ethics panel recommends censure for Chuck Edwards after harassment allegations
item.description: After a months-long investigation, the ethics committee recommended censure for Edwards because of "persistent unprofessional and inappropriate conduct towards two young female staffers."

item.title: Ripple effects: Three people have Reflecting Pool charges dropped after Hearn request
item.description: Federal prosecutors moved to drop their case against David Hearn, blaming Reflecting Pool damage on a "botched installation" rather than vandalism. That has implications for others who were charged.

item.title: With U.S. doors shutting, Cubans turn to Brazil for asylum
item.description: For years, many Cubans hoping to leave the island looked to the United States. Now, with legal pathways largely closed, a growing number are heading to Brazil instead.
